column1: # Xteink X4 flash layout (16 MB). Two 3 MB firmware slots allow safe
# updates (FreeInk RecoveryBoot flashes /update.bin into the other slot);
# the 9.9 MB "spiffs" data partition holds the LittleFS internal volume.
# The name and subtype stay "spiffs" because that is the partition Arduino's
# LittleFS.begin() looks for; the filesystem on it is LittleFS.
